scope: Scientific execution parameters for the retained measurement study. Descriptive extensions are outcome-informed; this file is not a prospective registration or biological validation.

thinning.method: multivariate hypergeometric without replacement; integer observed universe counts plus exact outside-universe count
thinning.eligibility: original QC population with total observed counts>=depth

independent_validation.role: independent alpha/beta state and count-thinning measurement test, not conversion, ancestry or functional truth
independent_validation.shared_feature_sensitivity: Rerank represented universe only, intersect each up/down gene block with represented genes and update block denominators; report G and block coverage; no aliases or new gene fitting.

ucell_exact.descending_rank: average tied rank of negative counts among the complete current universe G
ucell_exact.zero_counts: ordinary full-universe average zero rank, then min(rank,1500); missing genes zero-filled in original-universe analysis
ucell_exact.unsupported_universe: if G<1500 or n>=1500, mark method non-evaluable rather than alter cap

threshold_transport.decision_rule: strict score>threshold; exact ties retained; no optimized threshold
threshold_transport.recalibration_population: For each depth/draw compute target_depth_recalibrated q95 from all depth-eligible alpha cells, then apply that same threshold to the fixed-N>=10000 subset; do not recalibrate separately within the subset.
threshold_transport.small_group_rule: Retain all counts. State fractions and transitions require that state n>=20; AUROC requires both states n>=20; depth recalibration additionally requires >=20 depth-eligible alpha cells. Unsupported numerical summaries are NA with a reason.

matched_programs.quantiles: NumPy linear quantiles; exact rational comparisons for ties. Descriptive midrank percentile=(n_less+0.5*n_equal)/N; retain n_less,n_equal,n_greater and tie-safe interval [n_less/N,(n_less+n_equal)/N]. No randomization p-value.

gene_analysis.conditional_expression_scope: cross-sectional positive-cell means, not longitudinal same-cell expression
gene_analysis.concentration_definition: Occupancy-only, within each block: per-donor and equal-donor mean absolute contributions; shares abs(c_g)/sum(abs(c)); HHI=sum(shares**2); all-zero denominator NA. Top5/top10 use the shared equal-donor mean absolute-contribution ranking, not a different donor-specific selection.

influence.scope: Outcome-selected arithmetic subtraction with original universe/ranks/block denominators fixed; not an intervention or refitted score.
